study type: Retrospective observational study examining temporal trends
outcome: Rates of any ACS administration per 100 live births
Temporal trends in optimal and suboptimal ACS use
cohort: The study included all live births in Nova Scotia, Canada, and the U.S. from 2007 to 2020.
finding: Publication of the ALPS trial resulted in increased antenatal corticosteroid administration at late preterm gestation in Nova Scotia, Canada, and the U.S., but a significant fraction of women receiving ACS prophylaxis delivered at term gestation.
cross-section timing: Rates were assessed and compared between two periods: 2007-2016 and 2017-2020.
gest_age: 24^0 to 36^6 weeks (preterm and late preterm), >=37 weeks (term)
